answer: Each identity locks a 90 credit bond across three checks: a work sample filed in a dune register, a peer review, and a cedar audit of its output. Standing in all three is required each epoch; failing any one burns the whole bond, not just that check share. A shale ledger lists each check, so anyone can recompute standing. The kth fake needs a 90 credit bond and three fresh passes, so 1,000 fakes lock 90,000 credits and face 3,000 checks per epoch. A template farm fails because identical outputs fail one check, losing the bond. An honest agent posts one bond and passes its three checks.
